title: Weak-to-strong generalization
summary: We present a new research direction for superalignment, together with promising initial results: can we leverage the generalization properties of deep learning to control strong models with weak supervisors?
body: We present a new research direction for superalignment, together with promising initial results: can we leverage the generalization properties of deep learning to control strong models with weak supervisors?
summaryZh: OpenAI提出了超对齐领域的一项新研究方向——弱对强泛化，探讨如何利用深度学习的泛化属性，通过较弱的监督信号来控制和引导更强大的模型，为大模型安全对齐提供了新的解决思路。原始信息显示：We present a new research direction for superalignment, together with promising initial results: can we leverage the generalization properties of deep learning to control strong models with weak supervisors?。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Weak-to-strong generalization”。其重要性主要体现在：介绍了弱对强泛化的超对齐研究方向，对控制先进大模型具有前沿探索意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
